title: Luxury Movie Theater Chain IPic Files Chapter 11 Bankruptcy
主要内容: iPic Entertainment Inc. filed for bankruptcy in Delaware and may sell itself less than two years after its initial public offering. The Boca Raton, Florida-based chain owes about $205 million under a secured credit line and as much as $15 million to various vendors, suppliers and other unsecured creditors, proposed financial adviser David M. Baker of Aurora Management Partners said in a Chapter 11 declaration. The company lost about $57 million in 2018, filings show.
